channel.title: ResponderTX · Flood Ops
channel.description: Flood warnings, watches and advisories, flash flood emergencies, forecast river crests, and active notices for Texas. Situational awareness, not a dispatch system; call 911 for emergencies.

item.title: Flood Warning · Nueces River near Tilden
item.description: Flood Warning issued November 12 at 8:31AM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX. In effect until further notice. Areas: McMullen. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.

item.title: Flood Advisory · Los Olmos Creek near Falfurrias
item.description: Flood Advisory issued November 12 at 1:20PM CST until November 13 at 9:00AM CST by NWS Brownsville TX. In effect until Nov 13, 9:00 AM CT. Areas: Brooks. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.
